# Maximum Allowable Pressure

There is no single number for maximum allowable pressure — it depends on which valve construction (body material and pressure class) you have. The datasheet says:

- Steel and stainless steel bodies, flanged: consistent with CL150, 300 and 600 per ASME B16.34

**Maximum pressure drop** (the difference between inlet and outlet pressure the valve can handle) equals the maximum inlet pressure for the specific construction, except where further limited; see Figure 13 (standard valves), Figure 14 (Cavitrol III cages, liquid temperature vs pressure drop), or Figure 15 (NACE sour service valves) [p. 3].
